theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = 1 := by
  have h : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = Nat.gcd (n + 1) (2 * n + 1) := Nat.gcd_comm
  have h2 : Nat.gcd (n + 1) (2 * n + 1) = Nat.gcd (n + 1) (2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1)) :=
    by rw [Nat.gcd_sub_left_mul (n + 1) (2 * n + 1) 2]
  simp [h2] at h
  have h3 : 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) = -1 := by simp
  rw [h3] at h
  have h4 : Nat.gcd (n + 1) (-1) = 1 := Int.gcd_negSucc_ofNat (n + 1) 1
  rw [h4] at h
  exact h
